node.title: A=1 shape-A all-excess domain-map birationality
node.closure: every nontrivial minimal tensor presentation has a birational domain coefficient map
node.statement: Retain an official Shape-A all-excess survivor and any minimal tensor presentation G(t,X)=sum_(j=0)^(r-1) A_j(t)B_j(X) with r>=2. The domain coefficient map b:P^1->P^(r-1) is basepoint-free. Let d_X be its degree onto the image; then d_X divides n. Every U_0 point is unramified in its normalization fiber. The scheme-theoretic part of such a fiber outside U_0 roots all m incident Gamma fibers; each unit of outside fiber degree therefore consumes at least m from the residual homogeneous norm divisor. That divisor has exact degree 3en-Rm=2e-7=2m-3, so the total outside fiber degree across all fibers meeting U_0 is at most one. Consequently d_X divides either R or R+1. Officially R=3n+7, n is odd, gcd(n,R)=gcd(n,7)=1, and gcd(n,R+1)=gcd(n,8)=1. Thus d_X=1: the domain coefficient map in every nontrivial minimal tensor presentation is birational onto its projective image.
